items.title: Salt Hour
items.logline: A marine biologist returns to a dwindling fjord village to bury her brother and finds his last research notebook submerged offshore.
items.synopsis: Inge has not been home in eleven years. As autumn light shortens over the fjord, she retraces her brother's solitary winters among the fishermen who refuse to speak of him. What she lifts from the water will not be the truth she expected, only its shape.
items.posterPrompt: Movie poster key art for a slow-burning Nordic grief drama, in the style of A24's Aftersun 2022 poster and Neon's The Worst Person in the World, vertical composition with a lone forty-one year old Norwegian woman with ash-blonde collarbone-length hair, oversized charcoal fisherman's sweater under an open oilskin coat, standing in three-quarter profile on a wet stone jetty in the lower-right third, facing away toward a misty fjord, a small wooden rowboat slightly out of focus in midground, a half-submerged leather notebook glimpsed just beneath foreground water, low knee-height sea fog, flat overcast north light with no horizon line between matte slate water and pale pewter sky, desaturated cold pewter and seal-grey palette with one muted ochre coat accent, vast empty negative space across the upper two-thirds, the title "SALT HOUR" rendered in large Cormorant Garamond Light all caps with wide hairline letter-spacing in off-white bone at the upper center, and directly above it the billing block "KARIN VESTBY  .  EIRIK DAHLSRUD" in small pale dove-grey tracking-wide small caps with dot separators, 2:3 movie poster aspect ratio

items.title: Carne y Jazmín
items.logline: A retired opera costumier in Madrid takes in her estranged daughter-in-law, and a forty-year-old secret begins to perfume the apartment.
items.synopsis: Pilar lives among bolts of silk and the ghost of a son she barely knew. When Lucía arrives with a child Pilar has never met, the women circle each other through humid summer rooms. By August, neither remembers who first told the lie.
items.posterPrompt: Movie poster key art for a sultry Spanish domestic drama in the saturated late-Almodóvar block-color tradition, channeling the Pain and Glory 2019 Sony Pictures Classics poster and Portrait of a Lady on Fire 2019 Neon, tight vertical two-shot of a sixty-eight year old Castilian woman with silver hair in a low loose chignon seated in foreground wearing an ivory silk blouse with mother-of-pearl button, hands resting on a draped bolt of crimson silk in her lap, behind and slightly right a thirty-four year old Andalusian woman with dark chestnut waves in a sleeveless rust-red cotton dress, her hand grazing the older woman's shoulder, a sprig of jasmine on the silk, tall shuttered window in the right third with backlit jasmine vine, high-key warm Madrid afternoon light through gauze curtains casting 1:3 sculpted shadows, vermillion red, terracotta and jasmine cream palette with ultramarine accent, dust motes in golden air, the title "CARNE Y JAZMÍN" in huge Playfair Display Black Italic deep ivory cream at the lower third left-aligned with a hand-script flourish on Jazmín, and below it the billing block "BEGOÑA CASTAÑO  .  MARTA FERRERAS" in small warm cream small caps tracking-wide, 2:3 movie poster aspect ratio
